description: Reports which macOS permissions this server relies on are granted to the calling process, read from Apple's prompt-free checks: Accessibility (every macos_manage_windows action, list included; macos_manage_apps hide and show, and the window_title frontmost reads; the ⌃⌘Q keystroke macos_control_system lock sends before it falls back to the screen saver), Screen Recording (window screenshots), and Automation > Finder (macos_manage_finder frontmost_path, get_selection, and trash). No check sends an Apple event to another app, captures the screen, or can show a permission prompt. Each field is true when granted, false when not, and null when the check cannot tell, with the reason in unknown_reasons: Automation > Finder reads null until macOS has asked for consent and while Finder is not running. Notifications is always null, since macOS offers no prompt-free check for it. Call this before operations that need these permissions.
name: macos_check_permissions

accessibility.description: True when Accessibility is granted, false when it is not (denied or never asked), null when the check could not run (see unknown_reasons.accessibility).

automation_finder.description: True when Automation > Finder is granted, false when it was denied, null when macOS has not asked yet, Finder is not running, or the check could not run (see unknown_reasons.automation_finder).

calling_process.description: Name of the process that launched this server (e.g. "ghostty", "node").

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notifications.description: Always null: macOS offers no prompt-free check for notification permission (see unknown_reasons.notifications).

screen_recording.description: True when Screen Recording is granted, false when it is not (denied or never asked), null when the check could not run (see unknown_reasons.screen_recording).

unknown_reasons.description: Why each null permission field is unknown, keyed by field name. A key is present exactly when its field is null.

title: Check macOS Permissions
